title: Exploring the adaptability and robustness of the central carbon metabolism of Mycoplasma pneumoniae
authors: Zondervan NA; Yus E; Sévin DC; Martinez S; Gallo C; Schaap PJ; Lluch-Senar M; Serrano L; Martins dos Santos VAP; Suarez-Diez M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肺炎支原体中心碳代谢的适应性与稳健性，涉及代谢组学与动态模型，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制完全无关。
abstract: In this study we explored the adaptability and robustness of glycolysis and pyruvate metabolism of Mycoplasma pneumoniae ( MPN ). We used a dual approach, we analysed metabolomics data collected for a large number of OE and KO mutants and perturbation samples. Furthermore, we trained a dynamic model of central carbon metabolism and tested the model’s capacity to predict these mutants and perturbation samples as well as identify key controlling factors in central carbon metabolism. Our analysis of metabolite data as well as our model analysis indicate MPN metabolism is inherently robust against perturbations due to its network structure. Two key control hubs of central carbon metabolism were identified.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们探讨了肺炎支原体（Mycoplasma pneumoniae, MPN）糖酵解和丙酮酸代谢的适应性与稳健性。我们采用双重方法，分析了大量过表达（OE）和敲除（KO）突变体及扰动样本的代谢组学数据。此外，我们训练了一个中心碳代谢的动态模型，并测试了该模型预测这些突变体和扰动样本的能力，以及识别中心碳代谢中的关键控制因素。我们对代谢物数据的分析以及模型分析均表明，MPN代谢因其网络结构而对扰动具有内在的稳健性。我们识别出了中心碳代谢的两个关键控制枢纽。
